description: This file declares the VP9SVCLayers class which manages the state of K-SVC encoding with up to three spatial and temporal layers for VP9 video encoding. It includes methods for updating encoding jobs, activating/deactivating spatial layers, and handling reference frames and metadata.

classes.name: VP9SVCLayers
classes.description: Manages K-SVC encoding layers, including activation, deactivation, and reference frame handling for VP9.

methods.name: UpdateEncodeJob
methods.description: Determines if a key frame needs to be produced for the current encode job.

methods.name: MaybeUpdateActiveLayer
methods.description: Activates or deactivates spatial layers based on bitrate allocation.

methods.name: FillUsedRefFramesAndMetadata
methods.description: Sets reference frames and metadata for a VP9 picture to structure valid temporal layers.
